card: The plan composer keeps its own sealed plan: derive it from the daemon's live plan

apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/layer2.test.tsx::names the report a live plan was sealed from when it is another one
apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/layer2.test.tsx::warns when the live plan cannot be read and still allows sealing

apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/layer2.test.tsx::chooses options, seals them with plan.choose and shows the dispatch (extended: 'No live plan yet', plan.current refetched after plan.choose, button then 'This is the live plan')
deviations_from_card: testgen.ts and Layer2.module.css not touched (not needed). hooks.ts not touched: plan.current is read in PlanPage via useRpc and folded by planState.liveRead. Added a 'loading' state (seal disabled, 'Reading the live plan…') so a click cannot race a live plan not yet read. The existing seal test's script now returns not_found from plan.current until plan.choose, then the sealed plan (the daemon persists it) - required by acceptance 6 (sealed block from the refetch). base() returns not_found for plan.current by default. Sealed block heading reads 'Live plan <id> from <report>' instead of 'Sealed <id>'; it renders for live-here and live-elsewhere.
